question:
**Direction: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

It has been my great misfortune **__to follow a speech more notable__** for its volume than for any sense.

options.text: to follow a speech much notable
to have being following a speech more notable

solution:
Here, the correct answer is** No improvement required**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct in its current form. It properly uses the structure "It has been my great misfortune to follow a speech..." to express the speaker's regret.
 
• **The phrase "more notable for its volume than for any sense" correctly compares the loudness of the speech to its meaning, using "more notable" to effectively convey the message.**
 
• The other options provided do not improve the sentence but rather introduce grammatical errors or awkward phrasing.
 
• **Therefore, no improvements are required for the given sentence.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The first option, "following a speech most notable" creates an incomplete sentence, altering the meaning conveyed originally by leaving out the crucial 'to follow'.
 
• The third option, "to follow a speech much notable" isn't grammatically valid in English because 'much' usually modifies uncountable nouns, it isn't typically used with 'notable' which is an adjective.
 
• The fourth option, "to have being following a speech more notable" is grammatically incorrect as 'to have being' should be 'to have been'. Furthermore, even if corrected to 'to have been' it would create an awkward sentence.
 
• **Therefore, given the above analysis, the original sentence does not need any changes, and hence the correct option would be 2) No improvement required[**
